title: 73 Illegal Bangladeshis Detained In Hosur During Crackdown
summary: The Tamil Nadu Q Branch police, in coordination with the Central Intelligence Unit, detained 73 Bangladeshi nationals allegedly residing illegally in and around Hosur in Krishnagiri district during a late-night operation on Tuesday, 14 July 2026, as reported in Times of India.
